plain_english_policy: Determines whether minors charged with violent crimes are tried in adult criminal court rather than juvenile court.

effects.rationale: Prosecuting minors as adults typically results in more severe penalties, including adult sentencing and incarceration.
Juvenile labor protections (e.g., restrictions on employment for minors) may be weakened if minors are treated as adults in legal contexts, though this is an indirect effect.
Adult prosecution removes protections under juvenile justice systems (e.g., confidentiality, rehabilitation-focused proceedings).

evidence_quote: "Should a minor accused of a violent crime be prosecuted as an adult?"
